args.title: Add MinIO S3_ENDPOINT and bucket setup instructions to README.md

args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The instructions under 'Running locally' in the README omit mentioning that users must set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable and create the bucket when using a MinIO container. Updating README.md to include S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and bucket creation in steps 2 or 3 will resolve this gap.
